items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out in lane. Sell it when slots fill.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Heavy Barrage unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Swift Striker. Ultimate (Heavy Barrage) is available from Battle Vest.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Intensifying Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 2 purchases
items.legacy_note: Sell it last for a counter.

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Swift Striker completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Swift Striker completes 4.8k weapon in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Battle Vest
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Lifesteal, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Mini Turret: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Bullet Lifesteal completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Bullet Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-21,600 (levels 15-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Medicinal Specter T3, Spectral Wall T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Spectral Wall, damage) grows from 79.3 to 123. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Bullet Lifesteal, spirit 4.8k at Mercurial Magnum.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Bullet Lifesteal completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Bullet Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Escalating Resilience
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Fleetfoot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 7,200 to 8,800 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (1,600 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 11 to 45 spirit power. Imbued on Mini Turret: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Upgrade of Quicksilver Reload (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 21,600-37,600 (levels 26-32). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Mini Turret T3.

items.name: Berserker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,800 to 12,000 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 12,000 to 18,400 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you. Takes vitality from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Buy it earlier if most of their damage is spirit.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fleetfoot? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.
sections.desc: Dying after Fleetfoot? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They dive you and you've got no way out.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep you from getting away.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 18,400 to 23,200 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
